## Using git 

git is a command line version control system. We can use it from RStudio (via the "Git pane" in the upper left) or from the command line (i.e. in the "Terminal" tab)

The steps to using git involve:

- Initiate a git repository 
  git init
  or click the little box in R Studio
  
- Do your work (same as ever)
  add files
  edit files
  save files
  
- **Add file you care about to the "stage"**
  git add yourfilename
  click to add to "stage" in R Studio
  
- **Commit your changes**
  git commit -m "your wee msg"
  click "commit" button in R Studio
